comment: Audited deletions from the event registry. A grant is honored by scripts/event_compat_check.mjs only when the named shape is absent from every release tag's registry AND this PR actually deletes it — an unused grant fails the gate, so a grant can never be parked here for a later PR to reuse. Shapes that reached a release have no hatch: they need the v1 + v2 migration in README.md.
